objective_breakdown: 5 metrics: capacity_ah>=2.0 (baseline 5.0, easy); retention_5c>=0.95 (baseline likely 60-75%, hard; levers: thin electrodes, high porosity, small particles, high electrolyte transport); power_density_w_kg>=4000 (baseline est. 1.3-1.6k, hardest; P=Voc^2/4DCR/mass -> ~1/thickness^2 scaling via thin electrodes + mass cut); T_max_K<=333.15 under 4C charge at 318.15 K ambient (DeltaT<=15 K; P_heat/(h*A) with A=0.00531 m2 -> low-DCR design + cooling h); plated=false at 4C charge (thin anode, small neg particles, high anode porosity, high sigma_e; 45 C ambient helps kinetics). Trade-off: thinner electrodes help retention/power/heat but cut capacity toward the 2.0 Ah bound.
candidate_strategy: R0: baseline Chen2020 characterization (1C dfn + calc-energy, 5C dfn, 4C charge 45C dfn lumped+plating) + opening ceiling assessment (thin electrode + high-sigma electrolyte + high h combo limits). R1: 2-3 thin-electrode architecture variants preserving N/P (V1 ~0.6x thickness + small neg particles + electrolyte transport boost + h; V2 ~0.45-0.5x; V3 porosity/particle refinement). Fallback: retention/power/T -> Stage 3 params; plating -> anode particle/porosity/sigma; 3 strikes -> question assumptions (system switch or negative result).
budget_allocation: R0: 3 dfn sims + 1 calc-energy. R1-R3: <=3 candidates/round, each 1C dfn + 5C dfn + 4C dfn (+calc-energy for passers). Closing: deliverables, render, verify-deliverables. Flash target ~15-20 min wall clock.
risk_and_fallback: Risk1: 4000 W/kg may be unreachable for Chen2020 even at 35 um (positive solid sigma=0.18 S/m excluded lever) -> ceiling assessment; escalate to system switch or negative result with relaxation note. Risk2: 95% 5C retention needs ~35-40 um electrodes -> capacity ~2.3-2.6 Ah, monitor >=2.0. Risk3: T_max headroom only 15 K -> need P_heat<=8 W at h=100 W/m2/K; verify via sim. Risk4: 4C plating -> small neg particles (measured +14.6 contribution), anode porosity, sigma_e. Three-strike layers: model/system reachability, task boundary (h, system switch scope - widest interpretation recorded), metric reachability.
